summary: This informational RFC looks at the technical side of blocking and filtering Internet services. It describes common approaches and discusses their effects on the network and on users, including unintended side effects and ways they can be bypassed, to help policy makers and engineers understand the trade-offs.

eli5.summary: Some people want to block parts of the internet. This explains the different ways to do it and why each can break other things or fail to work.

questions: side effects of blocking internet services
